{{Quote|Time to abandon ship!|General Grievous|<ref name="Episode III: Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Escape pods''', also known as '''life pods''', '''repair pods''', or '''lifeboats''', were small escape craft for use in emergencies. They were standard aboard all [[Realspace/Legends|deep-space]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Are you sure this thing is safe?|C-3PO|<ref name="Episode IV: A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:Ionpod1.jpg|thumb|left|Ion mining ship's escape pod.]]
While there were as many different types of escape pods as there were starships, they all shared a few characteristics. The interior of an escape pod was spartan&mdash;passengers were expected to use the pod only for a few hours. Some pods seated as few as two people, while larger pods could carry over a dozen beings. Padded g-couches protected occupants from injury. Some models, like the [[Class-6 escape pod/Legends|Class-6 escape pod]] were designed to disallow mechanicals into the pod.<ref name="EP4NOVEL">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>

A simple piloting station provided access to the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], communication, and flight control systems, although the shipboard systems were heavily automated so the escape pod could land without a pilot at the controls. Sensors provided atmosphere as well as radiation and gravitational information about nearby [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and a limited comm transceiver scanned for activity on standard communication frequencies. Emergency homing beacons were also standard, often at least as powerful as an [[OmniNode communications set]]. Many escape pods were equipped with limited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] capability to facilitate travel to a planet on which to land.

[[File:PhoenixEscapePod-SWE.png|thumb|right|220px|The escape pod of the [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)/Legends|''Phoenix'']] diplomatic vessel was equipped with a hyperdrive]]
The interior compartments carried up to two weeks of rations, including food, water, survival shelters, [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrods]], and [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]]. Galactic law often required escape pods to be fitted with a [[medkit]] and at least one [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], though many times these regulations weren't followed. Sometimes an escape pod's emergency supplies included a civilian hunting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. In emergencies, survivors could use the escape pod as a shelter while seeking more adequate protection.

Escape pods had simple drive systems with just enough fuel to orient the pod toward the nearest habitable planet and assist in emergency braking during landing. In some pods, parachutes, maneuvering jets, flotation devices, or repulsorlift drive units slowed planetary descent and cushioned landing. Some escape pods deployed [[crash foam]] to prevent compressive liquefaction during hard landings.<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref><ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

==History==
Life pods carried aboard [[Tetan Corsair]]s were used by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] to deliver [[Krath war droid/Legends|Krath war droids]] to the surface of [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]]. [[Nomi Sunrider]] used an escape pod from the ''[[Nebulon Ranger]]'' to reach the surface of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] in an attempt to rescue [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] from the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]].<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> The escape pods carried aboard [[ion mining ship]]s in the [[Teedio system/Legends|Teedio system]] were small, simple spheres. When [[Vima Sunrider]] was piloting an ion mining ship, she became stuck in a magnetic loop, and was forced to eject in an escape pod. [[Tott Doneeta]] rescued her, using a grappling line to reel the pod into his [[Tott Doneeta's courier|ship]].<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption]]''</ref> On one famous occasion, [[Bastila Shan]], an amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], [[Carth Onasi]], and a few other Republic soldiers used these escape pods to escape the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|dying]] ''[[Endar Spire]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

[[File:Escapepod.png|thumb|left|250px|A Wookiee-built escape pod]]
The two escape pods carried aboard [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruisers]] carried 8 passengers each and could only be activated from the inside. Luxury life pods used aboard the ''[[Aurorient Express]]'' carried many more luxury features such as entertainment, increased seating comfort and lower shock.<ref name="Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express">''[[Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express]]''</ref> An escape pod was used by [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] to escape [[Havor]]'s spacecraft before it was destroyed by a [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Guardian vessel]]. The crew of the Guardian vessel logged in the escape pod and allowed it to land on [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], since its passenger would have been sent there anyway for violating restricted space.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Darkness">''[[Star Wars: Darkness]]''</ref>

The escape pods aboard [[Drama Korr's space yacht]] were equipped with four thrusters and a viewport. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] tricked [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] into one of the pods and then sent both pod and occupant plunging into the star [[Karthakk system's sun|Karthakk]].<ref name="Star Wars: Obsession">''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]''</ref> Each [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] carried numerous escape pods. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] prematurely released the pods of the disabled [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] in an attempt to doom [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to death.<ref name="Episode III: Revenge of the Sith" />

[[File:AoRCR_Chptr_X_The_Galaxy.png|thumb|right|250px|Escape pods entering a planet's atmosphere]]
The [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] carried eight six-being [[Class-6 escape pod/Legends|Class-6 escape pods]], all very simple in construction. Explosive separator charges ejected such pods away from the ship, and the escape pod's [[Distress beacon/Legends|distress beacon]] was automatically activated upon launch, although the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] deactivated the distress beacon on his escape pod just before touchdown on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to throw off [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] pursuit.<ref name="Episode IV: A New Hope" /> Later same year, [[Janek Sunber/Legends|Janek Sunber]] used an escape pod to flee the ''[[Rebel One]]''.<ref name="Rebellion 5">[[Rebellion 5|''Rebellion'' 5]]</ref>

When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Luke Skywalker's scout ship|starship]] crashed on [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]], he escaped the sinking ship in one of its four life pods. The pod ejected and floated to the surface, where it was attacked by [[ship-dweller]]s.<ref name="Star Wars 1977 11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref> [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] escaped [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] in one of the station's escape pods with the help of [[Master-Com]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 23">[[Star Wars (1977) 23|''Star Wars'' (1977) 23]]</ref> The escape pods used aboard [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigates]] were launched from the gunship's aft section. Luke Skywalker once used such a life pod to escape [[13-K]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 45">[[Star Wars (1977) 45|''Star Wars'' (1977) 45]]</ref>
